conclusion: In this paper, we present a theoretical framework for LLM reasoning problem in sampling-based test-time scaling, providing insights and principled guidance for designing better LLM reasoning methods. This framework decomposes LLM reasoning error into estimation error and model error, revealing the efficiency issues of the self-consistency method and effectiveness and degeneration issues of the perplexity method. To this end, we introduce R easoning-pruning P erplexity C onsistency ( Rpc ), which integrates internal LLM probabilities into the self-consistency framework for faster estimation error convergence while maintaining low model error and prunes low-probability reasoning paths to address the degeneration issue.
